name: AWEI KA13 Mini Portable Outdoor Wireless Dynamic RGB Bluetooth Speaker AWEI KA13 Mini Portable Outdoor Wireless Dynamic RGB Bluetooth Speaker
description:
Bluetooth scheme: V5.3, JL AC6966B
Channel system: 1 horn for single channel (8W*1+diaphragm)
Input standard: Type-C, DC 5V
Charging time: 3-4 hours
Play time: 4-5 hours (70% volume)
Li-polymer battery capacity: 1,500mAh
Waterproof rate: IPX6
Receiving sensitivity:<-85dBm
Bluetooth effective distance: 10 meters
Size: 120 * 100 * 100mm
Frequency response range: 60Hz~18KHz
Charging input standard: Type-C, DC5V
8W horn * 1 + diaphragm
Waterproof rate: IPX6
Compact and lightweight appearance is suitable for carrying outdoors
Compatible with various home and mobile devices with Bluetooth
Self-contained handheld lanyard for easy carrying
Play modes: USB jack/Micro-SD card/Bluetooth/FM
TWS connection in series: supported
Vigorous bass and clear vocals
Accessories: user manual and USB data cable
